address: 149 Dong Street, Licheng, Quanzhou, China Mainland
bio: A veteran chef hailing from Quanzhou opened this rustic noodle shop in 2022 selling only Hokkien hae mee, or Fujian-style prawn noodles. Bouncy noodles of medium thickness served in a broth simmered for seven hours with complex depth and flavours. Though the signature hae mee is a must, you can add your own personal touch with incredibly fresh and umami-laden seafood toppings such as baby lobster, prawn, crabmeat, squid or razor clams....
